description: Hi! I'm a Brazilian developer interested in technology, space exploration, programming, and game development. I have experience with Python, Godot, and interactive applications. Our goal is to combine creativity, science, and technology to develop an innovative project for NASA Space Apps. We're looking for people interested in programming, design, astronomy, data analysis, or simply bringing creative ideas to life. Everyone is welcome!
summary:
Lunar Space is an educational 2D pixel-art game that immerses players in the challenges of surviving and operating extraterrestrial habitats. Players begin on the Moon, learning to manage food production, solar energy, water and oxygen through interactive training activities. After completing their certifications, they travel to Mars, where more complex environmental challenges await.
Inspired by NASA's research on space agriculture, oxygen production and planetary exploration, the game transforms scientific concepts into interactive learning experiences, encouraging students to develop resource management, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
details:
Lunar Space is an interactive educational game developed using Godot Engine 4.6 and GDScript.

The experience is divided into two planetary environments: the Moon and Mars. Players explore space habitats and complete training activities focused on three essential survival systems:

  • Agriculture: irrigation, lighting and sustainable food production.
  • Energy: solar power generation, battery storage and resource distribution.
  • Oxygen: water electrolysis and oxygen production inspired by NASA's MOXIE experiment.

Players earn certification orbs by successfully completing each training station. A final assessment evaluates their knowledge before authorizing travel to the next planet.

The Mars stage introduces increased difficulty, including solar power calculations, dust storms and atmospheric oxygen extraction.

The project combines pixel art, exploration, gamification and scientific education to make space exploration concepts more accessible. Resource quantities are simplified for educational gameplay rather than engineering simulation.

ChatGPT was used as a development assistant for programming, debugging and refining educational challenges.
